opportunities.title: The Open Fund for Music Creators
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based music creators (songwriters, composers, artists, bands, producers or performers who write their own music) of all genres and backgrounds at different career stages.
opportunities.summary: Supports the development of outstanding music creators of all genres and backgrounds with grants of up to £5,000 for the creation, performance and promotion of outstanding new music, enabling talent to realise potential and reach audiences.

opportunities.title: Early Career Promoter Fund
opportunities.summary: Offers grant funding and capacity building support to recognise the vital role independent promoters play in supporting the talent pipeline across England, supporting the booking, programming and promotion of gigs, shows and other performances, and skill building.

opportunities.title: International Showcase Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based artists, bands, songwriters and producers who have been formally invited to perform or create new music at international industry-facing showcasing festivals, songwriting camps or conferences.
opportunities.summary: Offers grants for international export opportunities for UK-based music creators invited to perform or create new music at international industry-facing events geared towards music industry professionals.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Music Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based artists and bands writing their own music.
opportunities.summary: Offers grants of £5k-£15k for UK based artists/bands to break through to the next level of their careers, supporting recording, touring and marketing.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Accelerator Liverpool
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Artists, bands and future industry professionals based in the Liverpool City Region.
opportunities.summary: Targeted scheme supporting outstanding artists and bands outside London, and future industry professionals, in the Liverpool City Region to reach career tipping points with support of up to £5k.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Accelerator Tees Valley
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Artists, bands and future industry professionals based in Tees Valley.
opportunities.summary: Targeted scheme supporting outstanding artists and bands outside London, and future industry professionals, in Tees Valley to reach career tipping points with support of up to £5k.

opportunities.title: Composers' Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Composers with a strong track record already making a significant cultural contribution in the UK with potential for greater impact in the UK and overseas.
opportunities.summary: Gives direct access to funding at pivotal career stages for composers, supporting up to 15 composers per year for recordings, promotion, performance, international co-commissions, residencies, sabbaticals and more.

opportunities.title: The Hitmaker Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Songwriters and producers working in popular music genres.
opportunities.summary: Offers grants of £5,000-£10,000 for songwriters and producers working in popular music genres to further develop their careers and writing/production.

opportunities.title: Women Make Music
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Women, trans and non-binary songwriters, composers, artists, bands and performers writing their own music.
opportunities.summary: Supports the development of outstanding women, trans and non binary songwriters and composers of all genres and backgrounds. There will be one bumper deadline in the second half of 2026 (date TBC).
